scene: crouching beside a parked bicycle under a doorway lamp at night, stretching a rain cover over the saddle

intro.ko: 잉크 네이비 레인코트와 끈 부츠를 신고 안장에 방수 커버를 씌운다.
intro.en: An ink-navy raincoat and lace-up boots suit the moment he stretches a cover over the saddle.
intro.de: Tintenblauer Regenmantel und Schnürstiefel passen zum kurzen Halt, um den Sattel abzudecken.

deck.ko: 세워 둔 자전거 옆에 쪼그려 앉아 젖은 안장에 커버를 씌우는, 남색과 검정의 비 오는 저녁 차림.
deck.en: Navy and black for a rainy evening, crouched by the parked bike to get a cover over the wet saddle.
deck.de: Marineblau und Schwarz für einen Regenabend – in der Hocke neben dem abgestellten Rad, um den nassen Sattel abzudecken.

tip.ko: 자전거를 밖에 세워 두는 날엔 안장 커버를 코트 주머니에 넣어 다녀요.
tip.en: Keep a saddle cover in your coat pocket on days the bike stays outside.
tip.de: An Tagen, an denen das Rad draußen bleibt, einen Sattelschutz in der Manteltasche dabeihaben.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery); English product names only sentence-cased (sourceNameEn)

howToWear.ko: 처마 아래에서 레인코트를 살짝 열어 니트를 드러낸다.
howToWear.en: Open the raincoat slightly while under cover to show the knit.
howToWear.de: Unter dem Vordach den Regenmantel etwas öffnen, damit der Strick sichtbar wird.

howToWear.ko: 레인코트 아래에 슬레이트색 메리노 니트를 입는다.
howToWear.en: Wear the slate merino knit as a layer under the raincoat.
howToWear.de: Den schiefergrauen Merinopullover unter dem Regenmantel tragen.

howToWear.ko: 무릎을 굽히기 편한 스트레이트 핏을 고른다.
howToWear.en: Choose straight legs with room to bend at the knee.
howToWear.de: Gerade Hosenbeine mit Bewegungsfreiheit am Knie wählen.

howToWear.ko: 젖은 보도에서 발이 흔들리지 않도록 끈을 단단히 묶는다.
howToWear.en: Tie the boots snugly for steady footing on wet pavement.
howToWear.de: Die Stiefel für sicheren Tritt auf nassem Pflaster fest schnüren.

howToWear.en: Match the ink navy beanie to the raincoat.
howToWear.de: Die tintenblaue Mütze auf den Regenmantel abstimmen.

howToWear.ko: 안장 가까이에서 작업할 때 목도리 끝을 코트에 넣는다.
howToWear.en: Tuck the scarf ends into the coat before working near the saddle.
howToWear.de: Vor der Arbeit am Sattel die Schalenden in den Mantel stecken.
